The answer names these directories under `src/` as containing code that calls into llama.cpp:

- `src/inference` is the main one. Files there include `llama_cpp_backend`, `llama_cpp_sampler.cpp`, `llama_cpp_tokenizer.cpp`, `grammar_registry.cpp`, `orchestrator.cpp`, `adapter_manager.cpp`, `speculative_compat.cpp` and `tool_call_markers.h`.
- `src/facade` is the other one. `src/facade/entropic.cpp` includes `llama_cpp_backend.h` and reaches `llama_model_ptr()` and `llama_context_ptr()` for LoRA operations.

The answer also lists `src/core` and `src/config` as having no llama includes, so they don't count.

ITEMS:
src/inference
src/facade
END
